fichas.title: Storerooms
fichas.summary: Storerooms provide space for cleaning equipment, tools, cleaning agents, shopping baskets, luggage, washing baskets, and stepladders. Storage should be provided within the dwelling in addition to cellar and attic space. Storerooms may be niches or box rooms; doors should open outward, lighting should be operated by a contact switch by the door, and good ventilation should be provided.
uses: Store cleaning equipment, tools, cleaning agents, shopping baskets, bags, suitcases, washing baskets, and stepladders

fichas.title: Larder, pantry
fichas.summary: A larder or pantry should supplement general storage in a flat or house, with shelves extending to the ceiling. It stores food and drink supplies and relatively long-keeping fresh food, helping save refrigerator space. The larder is most practical next to the kitchen and should be cool, ventilated, and protected from direct sunlight. A freezer socket and possibly a wine cooler may be provided if required.
uses: Store fresh foodstuffs that keep relatively well
